fact: 1922年2月6日，华盛顿海军条约（五国条约）签署，签署国为英帝国、美国、法国、意大利与日本。条约规定主力舰与战列巡洋舰的十年建造「假日」，并按5:5:3:1.75:1.75的比例分配吨位；日本主力舰上限31.5万吨、航母8.1万吨，英美各52.5万吨与13.5万吨。巡洋舰、驱逐舰与潜艇未受该条约限制。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Washington Naval Treaty
sources.quote: Signed February 6, 1922 ... A ten-year pause or "holiday" of the construction of capital ships (battleships and battlecruisers), including the immediate suspension of all building of capital ships. ... Tonnage limitations ... Empire of Japan 315,000 tons ... 81,000 tons ... British Empire 525,000 tons ... United States 525,000 tons

fact: 1922年日本政局与军事部署同步变动：6月12日海军大将加藤友三郎出任首相；8月28日日本从西伯利亚撤军（1918年出兵，是最后一支撤出的协约国部队，完全撤完在1925年）。同年2月6日五国海军裁军条约签署，12月13日《四国条约》已在此前签订并终止了英日同盟。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Taishō era（Timeline）
sources.quote: 1922: Five Power Naval Disarmament Treaty is signed (February 6). Admiral Katō Tomosaburō becomes prime minister (June 12). Japan withdraws troops from Siberia (August 28).

sources.title: Wikipedia, Taishō era（外交）
sources.quote: In the Four-Power Treaty on Insular Possessions signed on December 13, 1921, Japan, the United States, Britain, and France agreed to recognize the status quo in the Pacific, and Japan and Britain agreed to formally terminate the Anglo-Japanese Alliance.

fact: 日本共产党于1922年7月15日在东京成立，是在共产国际协助与指导下建立的。该党1923年公布的目标包括：统一工人阶级与农民、承认苏联、从西伯利亚、萨哈林、中国、朝鲜与台湾撤军。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Japanese Communist Party
sources.quote: The Japanese Communist Party was founded in Tokyo on 15 July 1922

sources.title: Wikipedia, Taishō era
sources.quote: The Comintern realized the importance of Japan in achieving successful revolution in East Asia and actively worked to form the Japanese Communist Party, which was founded in July 1922. The announced goals of the Japanese Communist Party in 1923 included the unification of the working class as well as farmers, recognition of the Soviet Union, and withdrawal of Japanese troops from Siberia, Sakhalin, China, Korea, and Taiwan.

fact: 1922年7月成立的日本共产党在1925年《治安维持法》通过后被宣布为非法，此后二十年遭到「特别高等警察」（特高，俗称「思想警察」）的镇压：党员与同情者被关押，并被施压要求「转向」（tenkō suru）放弃共产主义、接受反共民族主义；拒绝转向者被关押到太平洋战争结束，警方对被捕共产党员常用酷刑。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Japanese Communist Party
sources.quote: The JCP, founded in 1922 in consultation with the Comintern, was deemed illegal in 1925 and repressed for the next 20 years, while continuing its activities underground. ... When the JCP was outlawed in 1925 with the passage of the Peace Preservation Law, the JCP was subjected to repression and persecution by the Special Higher Police (Tokkō), nicknamed the 'Thought Police'. JCP members and sympathizers were imprisoned and pressured to 'convert' (tenkō suru) to anti-communist nationalism.

fact: 1922年日本稻米丰收，产量6069万石（约比上年增500万石），米价因此从1922年8月的38日元余/石跌至10月的30日元余，11月29日元，12月26日元。次年1月回升至27日元、2月28日元，8月升至35日元。米价是当时日本城市家庭预算的核心变量。

sources.title: Kyoto University Economic Review, Effects of the Operation of the Rice Law
sources.quote: The rice crop for 1922 was 60,690,000 koku, or an increase of about 5,000,000 koku as compared with the previous year. In consequence, the price of rice fell from ¥38 odd in August, 1922, to ¥30 odd in October of the same year. It further declined to ¥29 in November and to ¥26 in December. In January of the following year, it recovered to ¥27, and in February to ¥28 ... There was a steady rise in the price of rice after February until it reached ¥35 in August.

fact: 华盛顿海军条约的5:5:3比例「使日本得以削减天文数字的军费」。日本的经济困难使海军扩张几乎不可能，日本意识到必须在美国主导的经济而非军事领域竞争，于是转向与美妥协：接受主力舰比例、在对华政策上采取更中立的态度、并同意自山东与西伯利亚撤军。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Taishō era
sources.quote: The treaty, which set a 5:5:3 capital ship ratio for the United States, Britain, and Japan respectively, allowed Japan to cut astronomical military costs. Japan's economic problems made a naval buildup nearly impossible and, realizing the need to compete with the United States on an economic rather than a military basis, rapprochement became inevitable.

fact: 日本在1921年建成并下水「凤翔」号，是世界上第一艘专门设计的航空母舰。华盛顿条约的吨位限制与建造假日迫使日本把已开工的主力舰改建为航母：「赤城」号原计划为战列巡洋舰，在建造过程中改建为航母，1925年4月时已作为航母存在。这构成1922年日本海军的技术转向：从建造战列舰转向改建与航母化。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Taishō era
sources.quote: In 1921, during the Interwar period, Japan developed and launched the Hōshō, which was the first purpose-designed aircraft carrier in the world. Japan subsequently developed a fleet of aircraft carriers that was second to none.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Washington Naval Treaty
sources.quote: Akagi (Japanese ship originally planned as a battlecruiser but converted during construction to an aircraft carrier) in April 1925

fact: 日本海军的作战条令要求维持相当于美国70%的舰队，认为这是在任何对美战争中最起码的胜算；但谈判开始时日本仅有美国55%的主力舰与18%的GDP。代表团团长加藤友三郎宁可接受60%（即3:5）的比例，也不愿与美国进行军备竞赛，因为两国工业实力差距会使日本输掉竞赛并可能陷入经济危机。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Washington Naval Treaty
sources.quote: Japanese naval doctrine required the maintenance of a fleet 70% the size of that of the United States, which was felt to be the minimum necessary to defeat the Americans in any subsequent war. ... Nevertheless, the director of the delegation, Katō Tomosaburō, preferred to accept the latter to the prospect of an arms race with the United States, as the relative industrial strength of the two nations would cause Japan to lose such an arms race and possibly suffer an economic crisis. At the beginning of the negotiations, the Japanese had only 55% of the capital ships and 18% of the GDP of the Americans.
